protocol.pixels: RGB [0,1], reconstruction clipped before metrics, no PNG quantization
protocol.mae: per-image mean absolute error; also multiplied by 255
protocol.psnr: per-image -10*log10(MSE), then mean; exact matches represented by null and counted
protocol.id: cosine(original embedding,reconstruction embedding); higher is better
protocol.id_input: aligned full 112x112 RGB, normalized to [-1,1]; no crop or flip
protocol.precision: FP32 inference, FP64 pixel reductions; TF32 disabled
protocol.scope: cross-dataset reconstruction evaluation; identity overlap with CASIA not audited
